{{Quote|The secret to our mouthwatering nerfsteak is the seasoning: a unique blend of Serrian salt, tertium, punctil and black hole pepper that's been handed down in my family for generations.|The menu at Dex's description of nerfsteak and eggs|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Black hole pepper''' was a type of [[Pepper/Legends|pepper]] used as a seasoning in cooking. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], which was located in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], used it to flavor several dishes. A 12.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] breakfast dish consisting of [[Nerf steak/Legends|Nerf steak]] and two [[gartro]] eggs used the pepper as part of a [[Dexter Jettster's nerfsteak seasoning|special seasoning]] which had been passed down in Jettster's family for generations and consisted of the pepper, [[Serrian salt]], [[punctil]], and [[tertium]]. [[Gartro egg salad sandwich]]es, a lunch dish costing 5.5 credits, also used the pepper along with Serrian salt as seasoning for [[gartro egg salad]] with [[Emulsauce/Legends|emulsauce]], [[Boontaspiced mustard]] and [[Taba/Legends|taba]] leaves all served on therm-zapped [[Pseudograin bread]]. As a dinner meal Dex's served grilled [[Opee sea killer/Legends|Opee sea killer]] [[Opee sea killer fillet|fillet]] seasoned with the pepper and [[Roonan lemon]], then served with [[celto]] and [[Iskalonian tartar sauce]] all for 9.7 credits. Each of these dishes was served<ref name="DaD" /> prior to the eatery's destruction in around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Having "space-y" names for science fiction food is the oldest trick in the book, but if you're working with something as goofy as Dex's, you need to have fun and throw in a few of those|Gregory Walker|<ref name="NFCL" />}}
Black hole pepper were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="DaD" /> They were one of several foods in the article which were given space based names, with the pepper's being a reference to [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]].<ref name="NFCL">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
